title: The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, February 5, 2019
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, February 5, 2019 Posted by admin on February 5th, 2019
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Boeing (BA), up +23.10% YTD and Procter & Gamble (PG), up +6.65% YTD. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +94 points.
Monday the Dow was up +175.48 (+0.70%) at 25,239.37.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +8.20%.
There were 21 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Microsoft (MSFT) +2.88%, Apple (AAPL) +2.84% and Boeing (BA) +2.47%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) -1.45%, Pfizer (PFE) -1.03% and Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) -0.98%.
Apple (AAPL) has reached a deal with France to pay an undisclosed amount of back taxes, according to the company’s French division. Media in France are reporting the sum at approximately $571 million.
Disney (DIS) reports earnings after the close today.
Markets in mainland China are closed all week for a holiday.
Today we have the State of the Union address.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly higher.
The national average price of gasoline is up eight-tenths of a cent at $2.264 per gallon.
